svg.text: Objective: Where does the 4B decider's clinical safety decision-making break? Tree pre-registered on 2026-10-31. Cases written from seeds, paraphrased by gpt-oss-120b and checked by code and
by qwen3-235b; a person read every flag. Case set 3635abfc8429. Thinking mode ran one case per family and condition.
FAILURE RATE PER MODEL, WITH ITS 95% RANGE
Reading: the critical fact is present
but not extracted from the record
a negated allergy is read as an allergy, or the
irrelevant history distracts from the fact
a fact at the end of a long note is missed
two statements disagree and one is followed
Computing: the fact is read but a value
must be compared, computed or known
a renal threshold (eGFR 30) is not applied
a result's magnitude is not recognised as urgent
a weight-based dose is not checked
a drug interaction is not known
Inferring: the state must be inferred
a historical risk factor is treated as current,
pregnancy stated only indirectly is missed
the critical fact is undocumented and the model
the record conflicts and the model picks a side
0% at the left edge of each bar, 100% at the right. A dot is the observed failure rate; the line is the range the true rate could lie in, given how few cases were run.
